orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPSS No. 1253 of 2020 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. Puran Singh Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. with Mr. 
Sushil Vasistha, Standing Counsel and Mr. 
Virendra Singh Rawat, Brief Holder for the 
State/respondent nos. 1 to 4. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to respondent no.5 fixing 
03.12.2020. 
Steps be taken within a week. 
Respondents shall file counter affidavits in 
the meantime. 
Also heard on stay application (CLMA 8734 
of 2020). 
As an interim measure, it is provided that till 
the next date of listing, the effect and operation of 
impugned orders dated 07.01.2019, 17.01.2019 & 
26.09.2020 shall remain stayed. Stay application 
stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
mamta 16.10.2020
